projection_types.name: RuntimeStatusProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded readiness/status truth from the owning runtime surfaces.

projection_types.name: AgentRosterProjection
projection_types.description: Windowed agent roster for shell navigation.

projection_types.name: SessionListProjection
projection_types.description: Windowed session list for a selected agent or operator scope.

projection_types.name: MessageWindowProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded chat/message window; not a full conversation mirror.

projection_types.name: MessageDetailProjection
projection_types.description: Capability-scoped detail expansion for one referenced message, tool, trace, artifact, or workflow detail.

projection_types.name: ShellEventProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded event stream projection for display/update only.

projection_types.name: SubmitMessageResultProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded assistant result projection for browser-style HTTP fallback rendering; raw execution state and full tool payloads remain outside shell plugs.

projection_types.name: BoundedSearchResults
projection_types.description: Bounded search hits over indexed projections, not raw payload mirrors.

projection_types.name: ModelCatalogProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded model catalog rows for shell display and selection; provider secrets and routing truth remain authority-owned.

projection_types.name: ModelDiscoveryProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded model discovery summary for shell display; secrets and raw provider responses are never returned.

projection_types.name: ModelDownloadProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded model download acknowledgement for shell display; download authority and raw provider output remain outside the shell.

projection_types.name: ProviderMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded provider configuration/test acknowledgement for shell display; secrets and raw provider probe bodies remain outside the shell.

projection_types.name: ProviderOAuthProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded provider OAuth device-flow status for shell display; access tokens and raw provider responses remain outside the shell.

projection_types.name: ConfigMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded configuration mutation acknowledgement for shell display; canonical settings truth remains outside shell plugs.

projection_types.name: AgentMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement for agent config/mode/tool-filter mutations; canonical agent state remains outside shell plugs.

projection_types.name: AgentLifecycleProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement for agent lifecycle ingress; shell plugs receive ids/receipts, not full agent profiles or contracts.

projection_types.name: SessionLifecycleProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement for session lifecycle ingress; shell plugs receive ids/receipts, not full session stores.

projection_types.name: MemoryKvProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded memory KV display/mutation projection; canonical memory truth and semantic indexing stay outside shell plugs.

projection_types.name: SuggestionProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded prompt suggestion projection for display; shell plugs receive short labels and optional detail refs only.

projection_types.name: ArtifactProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded artifact display projection for file/folder outputs; path policy and payload limits remain Gateway/authority-owned.

projection_types.name: WorkflowMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement for workflow registry/run mutations; shell plugs receive ids, status previews, and receipts, not workflow authority or full run graphs.

projection_types.name: SchedulerMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement for scheduler and trigger mutations; shell plugs receive ids/status/receipts, not scheduling authority.

projection_types.name: ChannelMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement/projection for channel setup actions; shell plugs receive display status and QR display data only, not secret/config authority.

projection_types.name: MigrationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded migration detect/scan/run projection; shell plugs receive preview/result display fields, not migration authority or filesystem truth.

projection_types.name: HandMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement/projection for hand setup and instance lifecycle actions; shell plugs receive display status only, not hand runtime authority.

projection_types.name: SkillMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement/projection for skill install/create/uninstall actions; shell plugs receive display status only, not skill registry authority.

projection_types.name: CommsMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement/projection for communications actions; shell plugs receive delivery/task display fields only, not comms authority.

projection_types.name: EyeMutationProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement/projection for sensory eye catalog updates; shell plugs receive display-safe eye rows only, not collector authority or secrets.

projection_types.name: IngressAck
projection_types.description: Bounded acknowledgement or receipt for a shell-submitted request.

projection_types.name: AuthSessionProjection
projection_types.description: Bounded auth session acknowledgement; shell plugs may update prompt state but never own credential/session authority.
